row_semantics: Each row represents a specific interface for querying the status of a side position light (either right-front or left-rear).

column_semantics.3: Description of the service and its purpose

core_entities.name: SidePositionLight
core_entities.description: Module responsible for managing side position lights.

core_outputs.name: SidePositionLightStatus
core_outputs.description: Status of the side position light, which can be OFF, ON, Error, or Unknown.

core_faults.name: Error
core_faults.description: Indicates an error state in the side position light status.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines two interfaces for querying the status of side position lights (right-front and left-rear) within a vehicle's electronic system. It specifies the expected status values (OFF, ON, Error, Unknown) for each interface.
